blocks.foot: Six guides, written in-house by the people who run the moulds. Where a number depends on your specification, the guide shows the arithmetic instead of quoting a price.

head.lead: Six guides written by the people who run the moulds: how many cups a project really needs, where the days in a lead time actually go, how silicone and rigid plastic differ in the hand, when a new mould is the answer, why colour drifts from the Pantone chip, and what an inspection can and cannot see.

blocks.h2: Ready to Build Your Next Drinkware Collection?
blocks.text: From product idea to pallets on a boat — tell us the product, the quantity and the date, and we will come back with a specification and a price basis.
